title: Start a protocol
description: Asks the principal to start the protocol identified by `protocol`, such as an Aries protocol's PIURI, with the requester, in the role `role` if given, with the protocol-specific values in `values`. On completed, when the protocol is carried in KERI exn messages, the result is its first message signed by the agent, as {said}; otherwise completed means the protocol was started by its own means and there is no result.

protocol.description: A URI identifying the protocol and its version.

role.description: The role the requester asks the principal to take.

values.description: Values the protocol defines for starting it.
